title: public immediate mechanics to raw stable ordered features; CANDIDATES_ONLY inputs only; no future traversal; revision 2 freezes real ids (CJK/hyphen ok), actor identity (actorId/actorSide/sides), actor-only cost, explicit hit-check applicability, closed input contract, unordered-multiset SUBSET semantics.

authority.claimDetail: freezes raw feature projection rules and first-batch five families (damage/resource/shield/attribute/judgment) minimum coverage; runtime feature compiler is not yet implemented.

allowed.name: candidateIdentity
allowed.source: prepareDecisionRequest(CANDIDATES_ONLY) candidate identity: candidateId/actorId/actorSide/actionKind/targetSet/paymentMode; provider/adapter never re-enumerates targets; actionKind/paymentMode are identity-only, no enum special-casing in the compiler

shape.candidateId: nonempty <=512, no C0/DEL control chars, UTF-16 code-unit ordering
shape.actorId: opaque nonempty unit id, same charset rule
shape.actorSide: opaque nonempty side id, same charset rule
shape.targetSet: unique array of nonempty declared target ids

allowed.name: publicSnapshot
allowed.source: public world snapshot: units (unitId -> public numeric/resource/state fields incl hp/hp_max/sp/sp_max/men/men_max/vit/vit_max/def/agi/shield/状态效果), sides (unitId -> opaque side id; must contain actorId and every declared target id), actorStatus (NORMAL/DISABLED/TERMINAL/UNKNOWN, required)

allowed.name: atomicFacts
allowed.source: Preview immediate atomic facts: eventId/sourceActionId/outcomeKind/expectedDelta + required hitCheckApplicability (APPLICABLE/NOT_APPLICABLE/UNKNOWN) + evidence.hitProbability (required when APPLICABLE); current turn direct projection only; no terminal/Pareto/roll

allowed.name: directFacts
allowed.source: PrototypeDirectAdapterV1 directFacts (DirectFactRowV1 rows) + legalityModifiers + opportunityModifiers + scheduledFacts

allowed.name: publicCost
allowed.source: declared public cost of the candidate (resource + amount), declared values only; resource enum 魂力/精神力/体力/生命; amount finite positive

allowed.name: publicProbability
allowed.source: public probability: declared 命中概率/触发概率 or Preview estimateHitProbability result; unresolved non-degenerate conditional probability is UNKNOWN

allowed.name: publicDeclarations
allowed.source: public declared axes: revealStrength, declaredOverkill, belief public fields (belief_prior_strength/confidence/uncertainty_width, PUBLIC_DECLARED only)

allowed.name: legalityFlags
allowed.source: declared hard-exclusion codes; every code must be a member of hardExclusionCodes, otherwise reject INVALID_OPTION_VALUE

allowed.name: legalityModifiers
allowed.source: adapter projection legalityModifiers; hardExclusions/legalityFlags code arrays restricted to hardExclusionCodes (outside => INVALID_OPTION_VALUE); judgmentRates/taunt/stateMigration/stateSwap/mechanismRemoval are metadata entries (counted, never projected)

allowed.name: opportunityModifiers
allowed.source: adapter projection opportunityModifiers (resourceLocks/opportunityConstraints/interferenceRates/dependencyTokens); metadata entries (counted, never projected)

allowed.name: scheduledFacts
allowed.source: adapter scheduledFacts entries; each entry requires entryId (missing => MISSING_SOURCE_REFERENCE); entries are never silent: they count into OUTSIDE_BATCH1_ROW_COUNT and their entryIds go to its sourceEventIds

forbidden.name: route
forbidden.description: no route/future horizon data may enter feature projection.

forbidden.name: worldClone
forbidden.description: no world clone/overlay snapshot as feature input.

forbidden.name: resultWorldCartesian
forbidden.description: no result-world cartesian product or branch world enumeration.

forbidden.name: wallClock
forbidden.description: no wall clock or nondeterministic source.

forbidden.name: skillRoleName
forbidden.description: no skill-name/role-name special casing; features keyed by mechanic featureCode only.

forbidden.name: teacher
forbidden.description: no teacher output/suggestion may enter feature projection.

forbidden.name: kernelRouteValue
forbidden.description: no kernel route value/route-reuse/prototype path value.

forbidden.name: branchCombination
forbidden.description: no conditional branch combination cross product; each fact row produces only its own features.

batch1PrototypeFamilies.purpose: first-batch five direct projection prototype families to feature family mapping; other admitted rows are counted only (OUTSIDE_BATCH1_ROW_COUNT), never silently dropped.

featureCatalog.source: unique declaration targetSet length; declaration targets only, never intersected with units and never claimed alive/actionable
featureCatalog.meaning: declared target count; unknown units still count; input targetSet uniqueItems

featureCatalog.source: sides-map equality rule only: t===actorId => SELF; sides[t]===actorSide => ALLY; sides[t] other value => ENEMY; distinct classes => MIXED; sides[t] missing for any declared target => UNKNOWN(SIDE_UNOBSERVED); empty target axis => NOT_APPLICABLE(NO_TARGET_AXIS)
featureCatalog.meaning: relation derived only from ID equality and sides equality; no id-prefix guessing, no neutral-side folding, no default ALLY

featureCatalog.source: declared publicProbability first; else atomicFacts with hitCheckApplicability=APPLICABLE and equal evidence.hitProbability => KNOWN, differing => UNKNOWN(CONDITIONAL_PROBABILITY_UNRESOLVED); all NOT_APPLICABLE => NOT_APPLICABLE(NO_HIT_AXIS); any UNKNOWN applicability => UNKNOWN(CONDITIONAL_PROBABILITY_UNRESOLVED); no atomic facts => UNKNOWN(MISSING_SOURCE_FACT); actionKind never special-cased
featureCatalog.meaning: current-turn success probability proxy; never impersonates realized hit; hitCheckApplicability is explicit per atomic fact

featureCatalog.source: public snapshot hp/hp_max per declared target, mean over declared targets; missing unit or field or hp_max<=0 => UNKNOWN(HIDDEN_AXIS_UNOBSERVED); empty target set => UNKNOWN(MISSING_SOURCE_FACT)
featureCatalog.meaning: mean current public HP ratio of target set (pre-settlement).

featureCatalog.source: public snapshot per declared target mean((sp/sp_max + men/men_max)/2); any target missing unit or sp/sp_max/men/men_max (or non-positive max) => UNKNOWN(HIDDEN_AXIS_UNOBSERVED); empty target set => UNKNOWN(MISSING_SOURCE_FACT)
featureCatalog.meaning: mean current public resource ratio of target set (pre-settlement).

featureCatalog.source: publicSnapshot.units[actorId] only, never target units: per publicCost entry clamp(available/required,0,1), minimum over entries; frozen resource map 魂力->sp/sp_max, 精神力->men/men_max, 体力->vit/vit_max, 生命->hp/hp_max; actor unit missing or field missing => UNKNOWN(HIDDEN_AXIS_UNOBSERVED); resource outside map or non-positive amount => reject INVALID_OPTION_VALUE; no publicCost => NOT_APPLICABLE(NO_PUBLIC_COST)
featureCatalog.meaning: cost affordability of the acting unit only; target resources never consulted

featureCatalog.source: publicDeclarations.revealStrength; absent UNKNOWN(NO_PUBLIC_DECLARATION)
featureCatalog.meaning: publicly declared reveal strength.

featureCatalog.source: publicDeclarations.declaredOverkill>0 is 1 else 0; absent UNKNOWN(NO_PUBLIC_DECLARATION); POWER-vs-HP self conversion forbidden
featureCatalog.meaning: publicly declared overkill availability; never inferred when undeclared.

featureCatalog.source: legalityFlags/legalityModifiers.hardExclusions/legalityModifiers.legalityFlags non-empty (first enum member), actorStatus DISABLED/TERMINAL/UNKNOWN => ACTOR_DISABLED/ACTOR_TERMINAL/UNKNOWN_STATE, target set empty => TARGET_EMPTY; code outside the enum rejects INVALID_OPTION_VALUE
featureCatalog.meaning: hard exclusion bit: 1 excluded, 0 not; excluded candidates retain full feature coverage.

featureCatalog.source: same source as HARD_EXCLUSION
featureCatalog.meaning: exclusion code; NOT_APPLICABLE(NOT_EXCLUDED) when not excluded.

featureCatalog.source: no source: settlement result is not a public immediate fact
featureCatalog.meaning: final damage axis always UNKNOWN(FINAL_SETTLEMENT_UNKNOWN); declared magnitude never impersonates settlement.

featureCatalog.source: no source: hit/evade realization belongs to the future
featureCatalog.meaning: hit realization axis always UNKNOWN(FUTURE_REALIZATION_UNKNOWN).

featureCatalog.source: admitted directFacts rows not belonging to the first-batch five families plus every scheduledFacts entry; scheduled entryIds recorded in sourceEventIds; nothing silently dropped
featureCatalog.meaning: unprojected row count so nothing vanishes silently; default 0.

featureCatalog.source: directFacts HP_DELTA row key empty or damage.power with unit=POWER
featureCatalog.meaning: declared 威力倍率 raw value.

featureCatalog.source: directFacts HP_DELTA row key damage.segments with unit=COUNT
featureCatalog.meaning: declared 攻击段数.

featureCatalog.source: directFacts HP_DELTA row key damage.penetration with unit=PERCENT
featureCatalog.meaning: declared 防御穿透 raw signed percent.

featureCatalog.source: directFacts HP_DELTA row key damage.type with unit=BOOL
featureCatalog.meaning: damage type presence bit: 1 declared.

featureCatalog.source: directFacts RESOURCE_OPTION_CHANGED row key=resource name with unit=ABS
featureCatalog.meaning: declared resource delta (signed).

featureCatalog.source: directFacts SHIELD_DELTA row key=shield mode/name with unit=ABS
featureCatalog.meaning: declared shield delta (signed).

featureCatalog.source: directFacts STATE_DELTA row key=attribute name (力量/防御/敏捷/魂力上限/精神力上限/体力上限) with unit=PERCENT
featureCatalog.meaning: declared attribute modifier (signed percent).

featureCatalog.source: directFacts STATE_DELTA row key=judgment name (命中/闪避/反应) with unit=PERCENT; single source: only the directFacts row, legalityModifiers.judgmentRates are metadata and never a second magnitude
featureCatalog.meaning: declared judgment modifier (signed percent); judgment row and modifier single-source.

featureCatalog.source: directFacts STATE_DELTA row with key not in attribute/judgment names and unit=BOOL => presence bit 1 (amount>0) or 0 (amount<=0, including removal rows which keep their row fact id in sourceFactIds); output domain strictly {0,1}; unit=COUNT => UNKNOWN(STATE_FORM_UNMAPPED) (direction not provable, COUNT never coerced to BOOL); other units => UNIT_FAMILY_MISMATCH
featureCatalog.meaning: state presence bit in {0,1}; only the provable BOOL form is projected as KNOWN; -1/other numbers are schema-rejected

featureCatalog.source: directFacts row durationTurns; 0 means NOT_APPLICABLE(NO_DURATION)
featureCatalog.meaning: duration in turns, raw; never multiplied into magnitude.

featureOrdering.rule: ascending (scopeRank, sourceEffectId, key, featureCode); scopeRank: CANDIDATE=0 (empty sourceEffectId/key), EFFECT_ROW=1; strings compared by UTF-16 code unit ascending; same input yields same stable order.
featureOrdering.rowFactIdRule: row fact id = sourceEffectId + '::' + key (empty key uses sourceEffectId + '::'), used by sourceFactIds.

valueRules: value exists only when status=KNOWN; UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE must omit value; 0 placeholder forbidden (UNKNOWN_ZERO_PLACEHOLDER).
all numbers finite; NaN/Infinity input or output is NON_FINITE_REJECTED.
status=KNOWN carries reasonCode OK; UNKNOWN and NOT_APPLICABLE must carry the matching reasonCode.
same (sourceEffectId, key, featureCode) is unique; duplicates are DUPLICATE_FEATURE.
multi-target counted once: RELATION_TARGET_COUNT counts the unique declaration target set once; EFFECT_ROW features never expand per targetIds.
duration never multiplies magnitude: STATE_DURATION keeps durationTurns raw; pre-multiplied inputs are DURATION_MULTIPLIES_MAGNITUDE.
judgment row and modifier single-source: JUDGMENT_DELTA takes the directFacts row only.
declared magnitude never impersonates settlement: SETTLEMENT_DAMAGE/ROLL_REALIZATION always UNKNOWN.
EFFECT_ROW features require at least one sourceFactIds (row fact id); missing is MISSING_SOURCE_REFERENCE.

unit family isolation: ABS/POWER/PERCENT/COUNT/TURNS/BOOL/PROBABILITY_0_1/RATIO_0_1/ENUM never mix; RESOURCE_DELTA accepts ABS only, DAMAGE_POWER POWER only, DAMAGE_PENETRATION/ATTRIBUTE_DELTA/JUDGMENT_DELTA PERCENT only, DAMAGE_SEGMENTS COUNT only, STATE_DURATION TURNS only, STATE_PRESENCE/DAMAGE_TYPE/OVERKILL_AVAILABILITY/HARD_EXCLUSION BOOL only.

compiler never hardcodes normalization constants: RATIO_0_1/PROBABILITY_0_1 come only from same-family public divisions (current/max, available/cost, declared probability); constants such as 0.4/100/refSpread are forbidden; cross-family conversion requires a declared public fact, otherwise UNKNOWN.
UNKNOWN is never inferred from zero: missing/hidden/unsettled values are UNKNOWN, never coerced to 0.
identity ids (candidateId/actorId/actorSide/actionKind/paymentMode/target ids): nonempty, <=512, reject C0 and DEL control chars; equality/ordering by UTF-16 code unit; CJK/hyphen/space allowed.
relation side uses ID equality and sides equality only; id-prefix guessing, neutral-side folding and default ALLY are forbidden.
cost reads publicSnapshot.units[actorId] only; target resources are never consulted.
actionKind/paymentMode are identity-only; the compiler performs no enum special-casing on them.
scheduledFacts are never silent: every entry counts into OUTSIDE_BATCH1_ROW_COUNT with entryId recorded in sourceEventIds; missing entryId rejects MISSING_SOURCE_REFERENCE.
STATE_PRESENCE direction is frozen only for unit=BOOL rows (sign mapping); unit=COUNT rows are UNKNOWN(STATE_FORM_UNMAPPED) and never coerced to BOOL.

BOOL output domain is exactly {0,1} for every unitFamily=BOOL feature code (OVERKILL_AVAILABILITY/HARD_EXCLUSION/DAMAGE_TYPE/STATE_PRESENCE; ROLL_REALIZATION is ALWAYS_UNKNOWN): KNOWN value must be 0 or 1, anything else is schema-rejected (INVALID_STATUS_VALUE).

unitFamilyIsolation.rule: raw values preserved in declared units; compiler only does same-family division and presence-bit mapping; no cross-family conversion; no conversion constant compiled in.

complexity.note: C=candidates; F0=fixed candidate-scope feature count (13); R_c=directFacts rows of candidate c; N_c=modifier/scheduled entries (each scheduledFacts entry counts as one entry). Each row yields at most its own 5 features; no cross-row/cross-branch combination product.

selfConsistency: featureCatalog codes unique and equal to the featureCode enum in BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1.schema.json.
every statusModel statuses agree with the statusReasonCodes vocabulary (incl SIDE_UNOBSERVED/STATE_FORM_UNMAPPED).
EFFECT_ROW feature sources all come from directFacts rows; candidate-scope sources all come from inputSurface.allowed.
batch1PrototypeFamilies mapping agrees with featureCatalog sources.
rejectionReasonCodes and hardExclusionCodes are each unique and disjoint.
inputSurface.forbidden names are disjoint from allowed names.
inputContract validates every POSITIVE case input; NEGATIVE/ANTI_PATTERN inputs are injection channels whose expected reject codes are in rejectionReasonCodes.

identityRules: sides[actorId]===actorSide; sides covers actorId and all declared targets; RELATION_TARGET_SIDE derived by ID equality + sides equality only; no prefix guessing/neutral folding/default ALLY.
COST_AFFORDABILITY reads units[actorId] only; resource map 魂力/精神力/体力/生命 frozen; cases include an actor-low-resource vs target-high-resource protection pair.
SUCCESS_PROBABILITY uses explicit hitCheckApplicability; actionKind is never special-cased.
RELATION_TARGET_COUNT = unique targetSet length; unknown units never dropped.
scheduledFacts never silent: counted into OUTSIDE_BATCH1_ROW_COUNT with entryIds in sourceEventIds; entryId required.

STATE_PRESENCE KNOWN only for unit=BOOL rows, value strictly in {0,1} (amount>0 => 1, amount<=0 => 0, removal keeps row fact id); COUNT rows are UNKNOWN(STATE_FORM_UNMAPPED); schema rejects any other BOOL value.
subsetSemantics is UNORDERED_MULTISET_WITH_COUNT_ASSERTIONS; expect order never represents output order; featureOrdering is the single global output order.
complexity expression has fixed caps and no branch combination.

identityRules.charset: candidateId/actorId/actorSide/actionKind/paymentMode/target ids: nonempty, max 512, reject C0 (U+0000-U+001F) and DEL (U+007F); any other code points allowed incl CJK/space/hyphen; equality/ordering by UTF-16 code unit
identityRules.sidesCoverage: publicSnapshot.sides must contain candidate.actorId and every id in candidate.targetSet; a missing side for any declared target makes RELATION_TARGET_SIDE UNKNOWN(SIDE_UNOBSERVED)
identityRules.sidesConsistency: publicSnapshot.sides[actorId] must equal candidate.actorSide (string equality); violation rejects MISSING_SOURCE_REFERENCE
identityRules.targetCount: RELATION_TARGET_COUNT = unique targetSet length (input targetSet is uniqueItems); unknown units are never dropped and never claimed alive/actionable
identityRules.noGuessing: forbidden: id-prefix guessing, neutral-side folding, default ALLY

subsetSemantics.rule: SUBSET cases match the emitted feature list as an unordered multiset: each expect.features entry must match some emitted feature by (featureCode,unitFamily,status,reasonCode,value?,sourceFactIds set,sourceEventIds set) with multiplicity; expect array order never represents output order; countAssertions additionally pin per-featureCode counts when multiplicity alone is ambiguous
subsetSemantics.featureOrdering: featureOrdering stays the single global output order for EXACT cases and for any consumer that needs the emitted sequence
